name: SS Venous Disease, Vascular Access and Lymphoedema

reference.source: ESVS chronic venous disease guidance, NICE varicose veins NG13, ACCP antithrombotic guidance, KDOQI vascular access, IWGDF diabetic foot and ISL lymphoedema consensus (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Truncal reflux on duplex earns endovenous ablation with foam for nests and compression for gaiter ulcers while iliofemoral thrombus earns catheter lysis and forbidden thinners earn caval filters. Diabetic ulcers grade WIfI for tibial revascularisation with cast offloading, torn vessels shunt-bridge on hard signs, wrist fistulas ripen by sixes with steal banded, and swollen limbs stage ISL for decongestive wraps with Indian-programme antifilarial classes.
